limitations: One frozen hour, provisional geometry and receipt time; not field-validated KPI accuracy.
Recorded masking validates local shape reconstruction, not changed-ID or cross-intersection associations.
Contemporaneous peers use observations after the gap; retrospective estimates are not real-time forecasts.
Multiple gap lengths/regimes can reuse vehicles; independent IDs and full fallback denominator are reported.
Screenshot purple markings are qualitative guidance; the exact screenshot window expired from retention.
Sparse supported groups must abstain. This method cannot promise every missing trajectory.

protocol.hidden_information_policy: Delete all hidden-band samples before segmentation and grouping; use observed-side lateral contexts only.
protocol.split_policy: Early half vs later half, 30-second embargo on each side; exclude later identities observed earlier.
protocol.decision_rule: Both partitions must add at least 5 distinct correct IDs across at least 3 sites, with no added false assignment. Fixed parameters; no later-set tuning.

limitations: Separate-view masking inside a sensor is not actual cross-sensor identity validation.
Repeated widths/scenarios reuse vehicles; totals are not independent sample counts.
Unknown cross-sensor clocks and unobserved turning traffic remain unresolved.
A later half-hour is not an independent recording day.
Baseline anchors are hypotheses and group labels are sensor-local.

display_policy: Group learned local refinements optional and experimental, never replacing defaults. Between regime method disabled.
